name: How long will the paint last on my kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: How long will the paint last on my kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: With proper preparation, high-quality paint, and professional application, kitchen cabinet paint can last for 10-15 years or even longer. The longevity also depends on daily wear and tear and how well you maintain the cabinets. Avoiding harsh cleaning chemicals, promptly wiping spills, and using soft cloths for cleaning will help preserve the finish. Our methods and materials are selected for maximum durability and a lasting beautiful appearance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professionally applied, high-quality kitchen cabinet paint can last 10-15 years or more. Longevity depends on proper maintenance and daily use. We use durable materials and methods.
